$comment: Reviewed by Nick by voice, 2026-11-03. Synthetic only. Source of truth for DECOYS.md and the scorer. Outcomes follow HRex $member-match notes mm-8..mm-11 (HL7/davinci-ehrx source, commit b5312b1, 2026-03-24; published IG v1.2.0).

targetPayer.$comment: Lab assumption, not spec text: the target payer cannot segment sensitive data, so it can honour a #sensitive (share all) consent but not a #regular (non-sensitive only) one.

consentKinds.valid: policy #sensitive, period covers the request date
consentKinds.expired: policy #sensitive, provision.period ended before the request date

cases.title: Control: clean card, clean demographics
cases.trap: None. Proves each matcher can return a plain match.

cases.title: Senior and Junior on one card
cases.trap: Rowan Quill Sr. (the subscriber) and Rowan Quill Jr. share the subscriber ID, first name, surname and gender. The request is for Jr. but carries no suffix. A matcher that stops at ID + name returns Sr. or refuses; one that demands an exact name with suffix wrongly says no match. Only the birth date separates them.

cases.title: Twins on one policy, initial only
cases.trap: Ada and Aya share the subscriber ID, birth date, gender and surname. The request has the initial 'A' only. A scoring matcher picks one; HRex says multiple matches SHALL return 422.

cases.title: Right person, consent the server can't honour
cases.trap: The match is clean, but Consent.provision.period ended before the request date. HRex: if consent is provided, inability to comply SHALL return 422. A matcher that ignores Consent returns a match.

cases.title: Right person, consent limited to non-sensitive data
cases.trap: The match is clean and the consent is current, but its policy is #regular (non-sensitive data only) and this target payer cannot segment sensitive data (lab assumption, see targetPayer). It cannot comply, so HRex mm-11 calls for 422. A matcher that ignores Consent returns a match.

cases.title: John's demographics, Jon's card
cases.trap: The member ID is valid but belongs to the C-055 decoy (Jon Roe, a one-letter name difference and a DOB eight days off). An identifier-first matcher returns Jon. The demographics and the card disagree, so the correct answer is no match.
